verification.precondition: An otherwise valid GenerationRecord resolves an accepted AuthoringRequest whose canonically ordered input map contains two GenerationRecord references separated by a non-GenerationRecord input, and the resolver also contains one unrelated GenerationRecord.
verification.stimulus: Execute tests/survey/initialization/generation-record-prior-input-subset.test.mjs with node:test, changing only priorGenerationRecordRefs to omit an accepted prior record, add the unrelated record, or reverse the accepted records.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Each omission, addition, or reordering is rejected solely with GENERATION_PRIOR_ANCESTRY_MISMATCH at /spec/ancestry/priorGenerationRecordRefs.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: GenerationRecord semantic validation rejects omitted, extra, or reordered prior refs against the canonical request-input subset
verification.forbiddenMutation: The validator must not accept a proper subset, superset, or permutation; infer prior ancestry from resolver inventory; or alter the GenerationRecord, accepted AuthoringRequest, or resolved resources.

behavior: GenerationRecord semantic validation rejects omitted, extra, or reordered prior refs against the canonical request-input subset
